//: Drives the typecheck/lint (`bun x tsc`). The lowering itself runs on the Go/ttsc engine during the Bun.build emit (build.ts, via tsconfig.ttsc.json). The authoring surface this app uses is `typefor<T>()` from @rhombus-std/primitives.extras — an ordinary generic function with no type-level footprint, so plain tsc checks it with no plugin and no `declare module` augmentation in the program. `types` is left unset so ambient @types discovery still supplies @types/bun, which the Generic Host's source (process.cwd()/process.stdout, node:path) reaches into this program for through @rhombus-std/hosting. The di family is dist-referenced, so its `types` conditions resolve the built d.ts directly. module:ESNext keeps relative + bare specifiers verbatim so node ESM resolves dist at runtime; the DOM lib supplies console + AbortSignal (the latter reached transitively through options → primitives).
